title: RSIV-Harness: A Recursive Self-Improvement Harness Framework for Open-Domain Conversational Text-to-Visualization
title_zh: RSIV-Harness：面向开放域对话式文本到可视化的递归自我改进框架

paragraphs.en: Users often request charts without knowing which database or table holds the relevant data. Such requests may be ambiguous, and users may ask follow-up questions to deepen their analysis or iteratively refine existing charts. A useful assistant must therefore discover relevant data sources among heterogeneous databases, ask clarifying questions when needed, and track evolving user intent while preserving constraints established in earlier turns. Yet recent text-to-visualization agents typically rely on static agent harnesses that are predefined and remain unchanged despite recurring failures across tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce RSIV-Harness , which keeps the language model weights fixed and applies R ecursive S elf- I mprovement to revise the surrounding harness from the agent’s own failure traces. To balance flexible self-improvement with stability, we introduce a four-layer framework that evaluates proposed harness revisions through anchor and memory checks, refining those that pass and restoring the best validated harness otherwise. We further introduce ODAC-Vis , a benchmark with 640 tasks for O pen- D omain, A mbiguous, and C onversational text-to-visualization that jointly evaluates open-domain data discovery, ambiguity resolution, multi-turn visualization refinement, and executable chart generation. Experiments show that a single round of RSIV-Harness improves all six evaluation metrics relative to the seed harness, with particularly large gains in executability (+28.02 points) and chart structure (+34.01 points), demonstrating the ability to learn from task-solving experience and turn recurring failures across tasks into substantial performance improvements.
paragraphs.zh: 用户在不知道相关数据存储于哪个数据库或数据表的情况下，常常请求生成图表。 这类请求可能是模糊的，用户还可能提出后续问题以深化分析，或对已有图表进行迭代式的细化调整。 因此，一个有用的智能体必须在异构数据库中发现相关的数据源，在需要时提出澄清性问题，并在保留前几轮对话中已确立约束的同时追踪不断演变的用户意图。 然而，近期的文本到可视化智能体通常依赖预先定义的静态智能体框架（harness），尽管在任务中反复失败，这些框架仍保持不变。 为解决这一局限，我们提出 RSIV-Harness，它保持语言模型权重固定，并应用递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement），利用智能体自身的失败轨迹来修订其外围框架。 为在灵活的自我改进与稳定性之间取得平衡，我们引入一个四层框架，通过锚定检查与记忆检查来评估所提出的框架修订方案，对通过检查的方案进行精炼，否则恢复经最佳验证的框架。 我们进一步提出 ODAC-Vis，一个包含 640 个任务的基准，用于开放域、模糊且对话式的文本到可视化，联合评估开放域数据发现、歧义消解、多轮可视化细化以及可执行图表生成。 实验表明，单轮的 RSIV-Harness 相较于种子框架在全部六项评估指标上均有提升，其中在可执行性（+28.02 分）和图表结构（+34.01 分）上提升尤为显著，展示了从任务求解经验中学习，并将跨任务的反复失败转化为实质性性能提升的能力。

paragraphs.en: While extensive research on natural language interfaces for automated visualization within the database and data mining community ( Luo et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2019b ; Yu et al., 2019a ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026c ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , recent agent systems increasingly wrap large language models in an agent harness ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) : a surrounding layer of system rules, tool interfaces, and control policies that govern schema access, SQL generation, and chart rendering. Industrial and academic agents ( Talaei et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) show that such harnesses can coordinate retrieval, query planning, execution feedback, and visualization. Yet most harnesses are authored once and kept fixed after deployment, while public benchmarks still largely assume a known target database and a well specified single-turn request ( Luo et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2019b ) . These gaps limit deployment in enterprise data lakes and rigorous measurement of open-domain conversational text-to-visualization.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管数据库与数据挖掘领域对自动化可视化的自然语言接口已开展了大量研究（Luo et al., 2021; Chen et al., 2025; Yu et al., 2019b; Yu et al., 2019a; Deng et al., 2026; Ouyang et al., 2025; Lu et al., 2026c; Xu et al., 2025），近来的智能体系统日益将大语言模型包装在智能体框架（Lin et al., 2026; Lee et al., 2026; Liu et al., 2026）之中：这是一层由系统规则、工具接口和控制策略构成的外围机制，用于管理模式访问、SQL 生成和图表渲染。 工业界与学术界的智能体（Talaei et al., 2024; Lu et al., 2026b）表明，此类框架能够协调检索、查询规划、执行反馈与可视化。 然而大多数框架一经编写、部署后便保持固定，而公开基准测试在很大程度上仍然假设目标数据库已知且请求是规范明确的多单轮请求（Luo et al., 2021; Chen et al., 2025; Yu et al., 2019b）。 这些缺口限制了此类系统在企业数据湖中的部署，也限制了对开放域对话式文本到可视化任务的严格评测。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark and task coverage. In enterprise data lakes, analysts often begin without a known target database, must resolve ambiguous requests through dialogue, and iterate on SQL and charts over multiple turns before trusting the output (Figure 1 ). Existing benchmarks address these needs only in isolation: open-domain and cross-database text-to-SQL ( Deng et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , controlled ambiguity in conversational querying ( Sarwar et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) , and multi-turn text-to-visualization ( Luo et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Rahman et al., 2025 ) . To our knowledge, no public benchmark integrates them for end-to-end evaluation with executable query and chart supervision throughout the dialogue.
paragraphs.zh: 基准与任务覆盖范围。 在企业数据湖中，分析师往往在开始时并不知道目标数据库，需要通过对话澄清模糊的请求，并在多轮迭代中反复调整 SQL 与图表，才能信任最终输出（图 1）。 现有基准仅能孤立地满足这些需求：开放域与跨数据库的文本到 SQL（Deng et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2025）、对话式查询中受控的歧义处理（Sarwar et al., 2026；Luo et al., 2025），以及多轮文本到可视化（Luo et al., 2021；Chen et al., 2025；Song et al., 2024；Rahman et al., 2025）。 据我们所知，目前尚无公开基准能将这些需求整合起来，在整个对话过程中提供可执行的查询与图表监督，以实现端到端评估。

paragraphs.en: Deployment and adaptation. State-of-the-art visualization agents improve reliability through fixed multi-stage workflows or within-task execution feedback ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026c ) . Three adaptation problems therefore remain. First, recurring failure modes such as premature code generation, schema search misuse, and cross-database boundary violations persist across tasks because the harness is not revised from accumulated traces. Second, improving reliability often requires retraining or replacing the base model rather than evolving the surrounding harness under fixed weights. Third, learning from failed tasks may introduce regressions, causing the harness to fail on tasks it previously solved correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 部署与适应。 最先进的可视化智能体通过固定的多阶段流程或任务内执行反馈来提高可靠性（Ouyang 等，2025；Lu 等，2026c）。 因此仍有三个适应问题尚未解决。 首先，诸如过早生成代码、模式搜索误用和跨数据库边界违规等反复出现的失败模式会在不同任务间持续存在，因为测试框架不会从累积的轨迹中进行修订。 其次，提高可靠性通常需要重新训练或替换基础模型，而不是在固定权重下演进周围的测试框架。 第三，从失败任务中学习可能引入性能倒退，导致测试框架在之前能正确完成的任务上失败。

paragraphs.en: Our solution. We introduce ODAC-Vis and RSIV-Harness as a co-designed benchmark and method response. RSIV-Harness keeps the language model weights fixed. It revises only the surrounding harness: the system surrounding the model, including its prompt, tool, memory, skill, and middleware. At each turn, an inner loop either clarifies the request or generates a visualization program, and retries with observed errors within a bounded budget. An outer loop evaluates failure traces on a stratified training sample and proposes a revision of the harness. Rather than following predefined edit rules, the outer loop autonomously determines which harness components to revise and how, guided by observed failure patterns. To prevent such open-ended evolution from degrading previously acquired capabilities, we introduce a four-layer stability framework that accepts revisions only when they satisfy both validation-anchor and regression-memory checks, reverting to the best validated harness otherwise. We establish formal guarantees that accepted revisions refresh protected records, rejected revisions preserve those records and restore the champion, the best validation score remains nondecreasing, and regression on sampled protected records stays bounded. To evaluate this experience-driven evolution under realistic open-domain conversational visualization challenges, we further introduce ODAC-Vis , a benchmark for O pen D omain, A mbiguous, and C onversational text-to-visualization. ODAC-Vis jointly evaluates source discovery across a fully exposed database collection, ambiguity resolution, and multi-turn visualization refinement, with domain-held-out evaluation and executable query-and-chart supervision at each code-generating turn. Together, ODAC-Vis provides a unified testbed for these interconnected challenges, while RSIV-Harness enables agents to learn from recurring task failures and improve their behavior across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的解决方案。 我们提出 ODAC-Vis 与 RSIV-Harness，作为协同设计的基准与方法回应。 RSIV-Harness 保持语言模型权重固定不变。 它只修改外围的 harness：即围绕模型的系统，包括其提示词、工具、记忆、技能与中间件。 在每一轮中，内层循环要么澄清请求，要么生成可视化程序，并在有限的预算内根据观察到的错误进行重试。 外层循环则在分层的训练样本上评估失败轨迹，并提出对 harness 的修订。 外层循环并不遵循预定义的编辑规则，而是根据观察到的失败模式，自主决定修订哪些 harness 组件以及如何修订。 为防止这种开放式演进损害已获得的能力，我们引入了一个四层稳定性框架，只有当修订同时通过验证锚点与回归记忆检查时才予以接受，否则回退到最佳验证过的 harness。 我们建立了形式化保证：被接受的修订会刷新受保护的记录，被拒绝的修订会保留这些记录并恢复冠军版本，最佳验证分数保持非递减，且对抽样受保护记录的回归保持在有界范围内。 为了在现实的开域对话式可视化挑战下评估这种经验驱动的演进，我们进一步提出 ODAC-Vis，一个面向开域、含糊且对话式文本到可视化的基准。 ODAC-Vis 联合评估在完全公开的数据库集合上的数据源发现、歧义消解以及多轮可视化细化，并在每个生成代码的回合中提供域外持出的评估与可执行的查询和图表监督。 总之，ODAC-Vis 为这些相互关联的挑战提供了统一的测试平台，而 RSIV-Harness 则使智能体能够从反复出现的任务失败中学习，并跨任务改进其行为。

paragraphs.en: Natural language (NL) interfaces for visualization (Vis) have progressed from direct code generation ( Maddigan and Susnjak, 2023 ) to curated benchmarks and agentic pipelines. Early text-to-vis datasets such as nvBench and VisEval ( Luo et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) provide large-scale NL-Vis pairs, enabling automatic validity and readability checks but not source discovery over a full database collection. Subsequent work extends coverage along three largely separate axes. Ambiguity-aware benchmarks such as nvBench 2.0 and CLARITY ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Sarwar et al., 2026 ) inject lexical, schema, or value ambiguity into querying, yet still assume a specified schema and stop at SQL execution. Complementary models improve robustness to lexical and phrasal variability ( Lu et al., 2025 ) and to ambiguity in interactive text-to-visualization ( Lu et al., 2026d ; Xu et al., 2026b ) . Multi-turn visualization datasets including Dial-NVBench, Text2Vis, and PMVisBench ( Song et al., 2024 ; Rahman et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026c ) support conversational refinement or progressive intent elaboration, but provide fixed table or schema context rather than open-domain routing across heterogeneous sources. CoVis studies neural and LLM-driven multi-turn interactions for conversational text-to-visualization ( Song et al., 2026 ) , and FeVisQA studies free-form question answering over data visualizations ( Song et al., 2025 ) . On the querying side, cross-domain semantic parsing benchmarks such as Spider, BIRD, SParC, and CoSQL ( Yu et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2019b ; Yu et al., 2019a ) establish standard splits for schema generalization and multi-turn SQL dialogue, while TACO ( Deng et al., 2026 ) moves toward unspecified databases and cross-database SQL composition. Text-to-NoSQL translation extends natural-language querying to non-relational stores ( Lu et al., 2026a ) . None of these resources jointly evaluate open-domain source discovery, typed ambiguity resolution, executable query and chart supervision, and multi-turn conversational interactions, which motivates our ODAC-Vis benchmark.

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement has recently been studied along three complementary lines. Weight-centric RSI agents such as AREX ( Lu et al., 2026e ) alternate an inner task loop with an outer audit-and-refine loop, but sustain gains through agentic mid-training and reinforcement learning over model parameters rather than deployment-time harness edits. Harness-evolution methods keep the base model frozen and instead revise prompts, tools, and control programs from execution traces ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Nie et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , including test-time program search, weakness-driven proposal with regression testing, and observability-driven component editing; yet they neither support clarification over open database collections nor regression-validated harness commits for coupled query-and-chart execution in multi-turn dialogue. Inference-time self-correction methods such as Reflexion, Self-Refine, and DSPy ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Khattab et al., 2023 ) improve individual trajectories through verbal feedback, iterative drafting, or compiled prompt pipelines, but do not commit persistent harness revisions validated across a task distribution. RSIV-Harness addresses these gaps by learning from recurring failures across tasks to autonomously evolve the agent harness, while using regression-aware checks to preserve previously successful behaviors.

paragraphs.en: We introduce ODAC-Vis , a benchmark for O pen D omain, A mbiguous, and C onversational text-to-visualization. Each task simulates an analyst who requests a chart in natural language without naming a target database, may need to clarify underspecified intent, and may refine the analysis or the chart over subsequent turns. The benchmark exposes all 206 SQLite databases from the Spider test collection ( Yu et al., 2018 ) and requires a model to discover relevant sources, compose SQL when multiple databases are needed, and emit executable Python that queries data and renders a Plotly chart.

paragraphs.en: Open domain and cross-domain. Unlike prior text-to-vis datasets that bind each instance to a known table or schema ( Luo et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Rahman et al., 2025 ) , ODAC-Vis treats the full database collection as visible at inference time while keeping the gold target as one or more specific databases per task. Models must route to the correct sources without being told which database to open, and cross-database tasks require SQL-only composition through ATTACH , temporary tables, joins, semi-joins, unions, or scalar subqueries rather than post-hoc Python merges. Evaluation uses a domain-held-out split: domains seen during training never appear in validation or test, so success requires generalization rather than memorizing a fixed schema catalog. Complexity is stratified into single-table (30%), single-database join (50%), and cross-database (20%) tiers within each split.
paragraphs.zh: 开放领域与跨领域。 与以往将每个实例绑定到已知表或模式（schema）的文本到可视化数据集（Luo et al., 2021; Chen et al., 2025; Song et al., 2024; Rahman et al., 2025）不同，ODAC-Vis 在推理时将整个数据库集合视为可见，同时将黄金目标保留为每个任务对应的一个或多个特定数据库。 模型必须在未被告知应打开哪个数据库的情况下自行路由到正确的数据源，且跨数据库任务要求仅通过 SQL 进行组合，包括 ATTACH、临时表、连接、半连接、并集或标量子查询，而非事后用 Python 合并。 评估采用领域留出划分：训练中见过的领域绝不出现在验证集或测试集中，因此成功依赖于泛化能力，而非记忆固定的模式目录。 在每个划分内，复杂度被分层为单表（30%）、单数据库内连接（50%）和跨数据库（20%）三个层级。

paragraphs.en: Column selection : “Show revenue” when both gross and net sales columns are valid measures.
paragraphs.zh: 列选择：当“总销售额”和“净销售额”列都是有效度量时，显示“显示收入”。

paragraphs.en: Aggregation granularity : “Show the trend” when the request can be grouped by month or by quarter.
paragraphs.zh: 聚合粒度：当请求可以按月或按季度分组时，显示“展示趋势”。

paragraphs.en: Filter logic : “Top performers” when ranking by revenue or by profit, or when conjunctive and disjunctive filters differ.
paragraphs.zh: 筛选逻辑：当按收入或利润排名，或当合取与析取筛选条件不同时，使用“表现最佳者”。

paragraphs.en: Unit scale : “Plot sales” when values may be shown in raw units, millions, or percentages.
paragraphs.zh: 单位比例：「销售地块」（Plot sales），其数值可能以原始单位、百万或百分比显示。

paragraphs.en: Chart type : “Visualize growth” when a line chart (trend) and a bar chart (comparison) are both reasonable.
paragraphs.zh: 图表类型：当折线图（趋势）和柱状图（对比）都合理时，采用“可视化增长”。

paragraphs.en: Encoding mapping : “Highlight categories” when color or point size could encode the same dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 编码映射：“高亮类别”，当颜色或点大小可以编码同一维度时。

paragraphs.en: Axis label : “Show enrollment” when the y-axis may label counts or normalized rates.
paragraphs.zh: 坐标轴标签：当 y 轴可能标注计数或归一化比率时，显示“Show enrollment（显示注册数）”。

paragraphs.en: Interactivity : “Make it filterable” when filtering by dropdown selection or brush interaction is intended.
paragraphs.zh: 交互性：“使其可筛选”，当希望通过下拉选择或刷选交互进行过滤时使用。

paragraphs.en: Every ambiguity is backed by at least two schema-supported alternatives that yield distinguishable query or chart outcomes, and each is resolved through a clarification question followed by a user reply that uniquely selects one alternative. Dialogues never expose database or table names during clarification.
paragraphs.zh: 每一个歧义都由至少两个架构支持的候选方案支撑，且这些方案会产生可区分的查询或图表结果；每个歧义都通过一个澄清问题加用户回复来解决，该回复唯一地选定其中一个候选方案。 对话在澄清过程中绝不暴露数据库或表的名称。

paragraphs.en: Conversational structure. Tasks follow one of two scenarios, which set the analytical role of the dialogue. In drilldown , later requests deepen the current analysis. In iterate , later requests revise the current chart. Ambiguity is placed independently of that role. Each task contains one to three ambiguity points on randomly chosen request turns other than the final turn, so clarification may open the dialogue or arise during a later drilldown or iteration. A turn that contains an ambiguity requires the model to ask the user a clarification question on that turn. On the next turn the user answers the question, and the model writes the visualization code for user’s intent. A turn without ambiguity requires the model to write the visualization code directly. Conversations are capped at eight user–assistant exchanges. The two scenarios appear in equal proportion within each split.
paragraphs.zh: 对话式结构。 任务遵循两种场景之一，这两种场景设定对话的分析角色。 在下钻场景中，后续请求深化当前分析。 在迭代场景中，后续请求修订当前图表。 歧义独立于该角色被放置。 每个任务在除最后一轮之外随机选取的请求轮次上包含一到三个歧义点，因此澄清可能在对话开始时出现，也可能在后续的下钻或迭代中产生。 包含歧义的轮次要求模型在该轮次向用户提出澄清问题。 在下一轮，用户回答该问题，模型根据用户意图编写可视化代码。 不含歧义的轮次要求模型直接编写可视化代码。 对话最多限制为八次用户—智能体交互。 两种场景在每个数据划分中以相同比例出现。

paragraphs.en: Step 3: Task generation. We build tasks with a chart-centric hybrid of templates and LLMs. Templates sample query intents, ambiguity points, and scenario-specific follow-ups from schema metadata, compile each sample into structured query, cleaning, and chart specifications together with executable SQL and Plotly code, and discard instances that fail execution or ambiguity checks. An LLM (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( Xu et al., 2026a ) ) then paraphrases the verified slots into natural dialogue. For drilldown , templates also sample a follow-up analysis path after the initial chart; for iterate , the target chart and iteration request are fixed first and clarification turns are inserted afterward. Each task contains at most eight user–assistant turns, and ambiguity points are injected at randomly chosen request-bearing turns. Dialogue length and ambiguity count are coupled so that one ambiguity uses three or four turns, two use five or six, and three use seven or eight; adjacent ambiguity turns are separated by at least one non-ambiguous round:

paragraphs.en: Table 2 summarizes the released ODAC-Vis corpus. The benchmark contains 640 multi-turn tasks over 206 Spider databases and 139 domains, stratified partitioned into 448 train, 96 validation, and 96 test instances. Rather than maximizing instance count alone, the ODAC-Vis prioritizes distributional control : every split preserves balanced scenario and complexity quotas, validation and test are held to equal size for stable anchor evaluation, and test domains are disjoint from train and validation so that success requires locating the right sources rather than memorizing a fixed schema catalog. Most tasks remain short enough for interactive analysis, yet the corpus deliberately retains longer clarify-and-code trajectories and a full cross-section of typed ambiguities so that models cannot succeed through single-turn chart guessing alone.
paragraphs.zh: 表2总结了发布的ODAC-Vis语料库。 该基准包含640个多轮任务，覆盖206个Spider数据库和139个领域，并按分层方式划分为448个训练、96个验证和96个测试实例。 ODAC-Vis并不单纯追求实例数量的最大化，而是优先考虑分布控制：每个划分都保持均衡的场景与复杂度配额，验证集与测试集保持相同规模以便进行稳定的锚点评估，且测试领域与训练和验证领域互不重叠，从而成功完成任务需要定位正确的数据来源，而非记忆固定的模式目录。 大多数任务的篇幅仍足够短，适合交互式分析，但该语料库刻意保留了较长的澄清与编码轨迹以及各类歧义类型的完整横截面，使模型无法仅凭单轮图表猜测获得成功。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 situates ODAC-Vis against six representative text-to-visualization and data-access benchmarks. Existing resources typically isolate one deployment challenge at a time: single-turn text-to-vis sets assume a known table or database; conversational benchmarks add dialogue but keep the schema fixed; ambiguity-aware corpora annotate alternative encodings without requiring clarification turns; and open-domain text-to-SQL benchmarks such as TACO ( Deng et al., 2026 ) evaluate cross-database retrieval and composition in SQL alone, without executable chart supervision. ODAC-Vis is designed to stress-test the full analyst workflow in one benchmark: models must discover target sources from a fully exposed 206-database collection under a domain-held-out split, resolve typed ambiguities through clarify dialogue, compose evidence across databases when needed, and emit verified Python programs with reference charts at every code turn. To our knowledge, it is the only corpus in the comparison that jointly supports Python chart generation, open-domain access, cross-domain evaluation, multi-turn dialogue, verified ambiguity gold, and cross-database SQL composition.

paragraphs.en: Benchmark comparisons are only meaningful when the underlying supervision is faithful to the stated task. We therefore conduct a controlled quality audit of ODAC-Vis together with two widely used text-to-visualization resources: Dial-NVBench ( Song et al., 2024 ) , which models multi-turn visualization dialogue over a fixed given table or schema, and NVBench 2.0 ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , which injects ambiguity into the request and retains multiple valid chart specifications per request.
paragraphs.zh: 基准比较只有在底层监督忠实于所述任务时才有意义。 因此，我们对 ODAC-Vis 以及两个广泛使用的文本到可视化资源进行了受控质量审计：Dial-NVBench（Song 等，2024），它在固定的给定表格或模式上建模多轮可视化对话；以及 NVBench 2.0（Luo 等，2025），它在请求中注入歧义并为每个请求保留多个有效的图表规范。

paragraphs.en: Each instance receives three independent scores on a 0–100 scale:
paragraphs.zh: 每个实例在 0–100 的量表上获得三个独立分数：

paragraphs.en: Relevance : whether the gold answer targets the analysis implied by the request.
paragraphs.zh: 相关性：标准答案是否针对请求所隐含的分析。

paragraphs.en: Plausibility : whether the answer satisfies stated constraints and forms a coherent query or chart specification.
paragraphs.zh: 合理性：答案是否满足既定约束，并构成一个连贯的查询或图表规范。

paragraphs.en: Readability : presentation quality of the answer text and, when applicable, the reference chart.
paragraphs.zh: 可读性：答案文本的呈现质量，以及（如适用）参考图表的呈现质量。

paragraphs.en: The audit applies this rubric to the gold supervision in each corpus as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 该审计将此评分标准应用于每个语料库中的黄金监督，具体如下：

paragraphs.en: ODAC-Vis : multi-turn clarification and code turns, with reference charts produced from verified executable code.
paragraphs.zh: ODAC-Vis：多轮澄清与代码轮次，参考图表由经验证的可执行代码生成。

paragraphs.en: Dial-NVBench: conversational question–answer trajectories toward the final visualization goal.
paragraphs.zh: Dial-NVBench：面向最终可视化目标的对话式问答轨迹。

paragraphs.en: NVBench 2.0: natural-language requests against gold Vega-Lite specifications and rendered reference charts when multiple valid encodings are annotated.

paragraphs.en: We randomly sample 100 tasks from each benchmark with a fixed seed so that both evaluators inspect the same instances. Two experts conduct a blind review using the shared rubric described above, with dataset identity and task provenance concealed. An LLM evaluator (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) applies the same dimensions with structured prompts and returns a score together with a short rationale for each task. Both protocols score one instance at a time along a single dimension, yielding three judgments per task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以固定随机种子从每个基准中随机抽取100个任务，确保两位评估者审查相同的实例。 两名专家使用上述共享评分标准进行盲审，数据集身份和任务来源均被隐藏。 一个LLM评估器（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）使用结构化提示词应用相同维度，并为每个任务返回一个分数及简短理由。 两种协议均按单一维度逐个实例评分，每个任务产生三项判断。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 summarizes the mean scores. ODAC-Vis attains the highest quality across all dimensions, reaching 93.6/82.1/87.3 under expert review and 91.8/78.7/86.2 under LLM evaluation. Both evaluation modes agree on the relative ordering of the three corpora. The advantage of ODAC-Vis is most visible on readability, where execution-validated reference charts and typed ambiguity resolution yield clearer supervision than alternative gold encodings in NVBench 2.0. paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows one task of ODAC-Vis . The user states a chart request and does not name a database. The model first judges whether the request is ambiguous. The opening request already fixes the analysis: a bar chart of the average height for each hometown. Because the measure, the grouping, and the chart type are all specified, no clarification is required. The model locates the database that can answer the request, retrieves the corresponding rows, and writes visualization code that renders the chart.

paragraphs.en: This section proceeds from the architecture to the inner loop, then to the outer self-improvement loop, and finally to the four-layer stability rules and the theorems that follow from them.
paragraphs.zh: 本节从架构出发，接着介绍内循环，然后是外层自我改进循环，最后介绍四层稳定性规则以及由其推导出的定理。

paragraphs.en: Existing visualization systems still face a fundamental limit that blocks practical deployment. A traditional pipeline fixes its procedure before the first request, so a failure that keeps recurring can be removed only by rewriting that procedure or by retraining the model. Harness agents improve on this design: a frozen model can choose its next action from the observation it has just received. The harness that governs the choice is nevertheless fixed at deployment, so the agent stays rigid and has little flexibility once the scenario grows more complex than the behavior written for it. To address this limitation, we propose RSIV-Harness , which keeps the harness as the acting layer of a frozen model and adds self-improvement that revises the harness from failures accumulated across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的可视化系统仍然面临一个阻碍实际部署的根本性限制。 传统流水线在第一个请求到来之前就固定了其流程，因此反复出现的失败只能通过重写该流程或重新训练模型来消除。 Harness 智能体改进了这一设计：冻结的模型可以根据刚收到的观测来选择下一步动作。 然而，支配这一选择的 harness 在部署时就已固定，因此智能体依然僵化，一旦场景变得比为其编写的行为更复杂，就几乎没有灵活性。 为解决这一限制，我们提出 RSIV-Harness，它将 harness 保留为冻结模型的执行层，并加入自我改进机制，利用跨任务积累的失败来修订 harness。

sents.en: To address this limitation, we propose RSIV-Harness , which keeps the harness as the acting layer of a frozen model and adds self-improvement that revises the harness from failures accumulated across tasks.
sents.zh: 为解决这一限制，我们提出 RSIV-Harness，它将 harness 保留为冻结模型的执行层，并加入自我改进机制，利用跨任务积累的失败来修订 harness。

paragraphs.en: RSIV-Harness implements a hierarchical, bi-level recursive self-improvement process, comprising an inner task-solving loop and an outer self-improvement loop (Fig. 4 ). The inner loop answers one assistant turn by following the harness that is currently deployed. The outer loop reads the traces of many such turns and proposes a revision of that harness. A four-layer stability rule framework then accepts or rejects the revision before it can replace the deployed harness. The inner loop therefore supplies the evidence, the outer loop turns that evidence into a candidate, and the rules decide which harness the next inner loop will use. Self-improvement starts from a minimal harness, leaves the outer loop free to choose what to refine and how to refine it, and uses the refine, restart, anchor check, and memory check rules as the hard constraints that keep this freedom stable.
paragraphs.zh: RSIV-Harness 实现了一个分层的双层递归自我改进过程，由一个内部任务解决循环和一个外部自我改进循环组成（图 4）。 内部循环通过遵循当前部署的执行框架（harness）来回答助手的一轮对话。 外部循环读取许多此类对话轮次的轨迹，并提出对该执行框架的修订。 四层稳定性规则框架随后接受或拒绝该修订，之后修订才能替换已部署的执行框架。 因此，内部循环提供证据，外部循环将证据转化为候选方案，而规则决定下一个内部循环将使用哪个执行框架。 自我改进从一个最小化的执行框架出发，让外部循环自由选择改进什么以及如何改进，并使用 refine、restart、anchor check 和 memory check 规则作为硬约束，以保持这种自由度的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: All experiments use ODAC-Vis . We use the train split to drive the outer loop of RSIV-Harness . The stratified training panel S S contains 48 tasks from train only domains. Their failure traces are analyzed to propose harness edits. The anchor check evaluates every candidate on a panel of 48 validation tasks. Each panel contains one task for every combination of the three difficulty tiers, the eight ambiguity types, and the two conversation scenarios. All of the test split is reserved exclusively for final evaluation. It comprises 96 tasks over 15 held-out domains that never appear in train or validation, so reported scores measure open-domain source discovery, ambiguity handling, and multi-turn chart generation rather than memorization of a fixed schema catalog. All baselines and evolved harness variants are evaluated on this test split under model history: each turn conditions on the model’s own prior assistant outputs within the same task.
paragraphs.zh: 所有实验均使用 ODAC-Vis。 我们使用训练集划分来驱动 RSIV-Harness 的外层循环。 分层训练面板 S S 包含仅来自 train 域的 48 个任务。 对它们的失败轨迹进行分析，以提出 harness 的修改方案。 锚点检查在一个包含 48 个验证任务的面板上评估每个候选方案。 每个面板针对三个难度层级、八种歧义类型和两种对话场景的每一种组合各包含一个任务。 全部测试集划分被专门保留用于最终评估。 它包含 15 个保留域（held-out domains）上的 96 个任务，这些域从未出现在 train 或 validation 中，因此所报告的分数衡量的是开放域的源发现、歧义处理和多轮图表生成能力，而非对固定模式目录的记忆。 所有基线方法和演化的 harness 变体都在 model history 设置下于该测试集划分上进行评估：每一轮都以同一任务内模型自身先前的助手输出为条件。

paragraphs.en: The GPT results test whether a harness evolved only with DeepSeek can transfer to another backbone without further optimization. Compared with the static GPT harness, the frozen evolved harness improves five of six metrics. The gains are 9.34 points in executability, 19.07 in database routing, 7.50 in stance accuracy, 1.72 in clarification quality, and 8.35 in chart structure. Execution accuracy is 0.78 points lower. The transferred system is nevertheless slightly below the strongest GPT baseline on most individual metrics. The deficits are 4.67 points for executability, 1.55 for routing, 0.25 for stance, 0.78 for execution accuracy, and 0.01 for chart structure. It achieves the best clarification score at 3.74. These results demonstrate the applicability of RSIV-Harness across open-source and proprietary LLM backbones, with harness improvements learned from one model remaining transferable to another without adaptation, although some performance gains remain dependent on the model used during evolution.

paragraphs.en: To isolate the effect of stability rules, we repeat one round of harness evolution with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash after removing the stability rule framework, keeping all other settings unchanged. The resulting harness is then frozen and evaluated on the test split using the same model. As shown in Table 4 , removing the stability rules leads to performance degradation across all six metrics: executability drops by 9.73 points, database routing by 3.12, stance accuracy by 2.50, execution accuracy by 3.50, clarification quality by 2.74, and chart structure by 9.53. The largest declines occur in executability and chart structure, while the reductions in routing, stance, and clarification quality indicate that the framework contributes to multiple aspects of conversational visualization rather than merely filtering invalid programs. These results highlight the importance of stability rules in guiding harness evolution, helping preserve previously successful behaviors while enabling improvements from accumulated task failures.

paragraphs.en: We present a cross-database visualization task involving two car-racing databases joined by driver ID to demonstrate the capabilities of RSIV-Harness . The user first requests a bar chart of average driver age, then excludes Kasey Kahne and uses color to encode vehicle make. The reference chart (Figure 5(a) ) therefore contains nine drivers across three makes. Direct Prompt and ReAct distort the ages and chart orientation, with ReAct omitting six drivers. H 0 H_{0} incorrectly concatenates driver names across sources. MultiVis-Agent keeps the nine names but shifts the ages, for example drawing Bobby Labonte at 26.5 rather than 28. In contrast, RSIV-Harness preserves the correct drivers, ages, and make-based encoding, closely matching the reference chart. This demonstrates its ability to integrate cross-database evidence while respecting multi-turn refinements.

paragraphs.en: We presented ODAC-Vis and RSIV-Harness as a benchmark and method for open domain conversational text to visualization. ODAC-Vis evaluates source discovery, ambiguity resolution, and multi turn chart refinement under held out domains. RSIV-Harness improves the harness around a fixed language model through recursive analysis of failure traces. Its stability rules provide explicit guarantees for protected record refresh, champion restoration, anchor monotonicity, and bounded regression. On the test split, a single round of recursive self-improvement improves the DeepSeek-based harness across all six evaluation metrics. The same frozen harness also transfers competitively to GPT-6 Luna. Ablations further show that the stability rules improve all reported metrics and that the harness components make complementary contributions. These findings establish harness evolution as a practical path for improving conversational visualization agents.
